get.description: Retrieves end of day account performance including balances, cash flows, rate of return and a variety of attributes by accountNo.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Used for frequency of response. D = Daily, W = Weekly, M = Monthly, Y = Yearly.

200.description: Retrieving Account Performance details by accountID was Successful.

accountNo.description: The user's unique account number, that is human readable.

realizedDayPL.description: The actual profit or loss on the day in USD.

unrealizedDayPL.description: Current unrealized profit and loss for open positions in account.

cumRealizedPL.description: The cumulative realized profit/loss from inception of account, each day adds to previous days.

date.description: the date of the performance arrays values.

equity.description: Invested equity (excluding cash) for this day (see performance.date). For Total `Equity` add performance.equity and performance.cash

cash.description: The total cash balance (settled and unsettled) for this day (see performance.date).

deposits.description: The total amount of deposits calculated from 4pm of previous day until current time.

withdrawals.description: The total amount of withdrawals calculated from 4pm of previous day until current time.

fees.description: The total amount of fees calculated from 4pm of previous day until current time.

startDate.description: Requested start date of the accounts performance period.

endDate.description: Requested end date of the accounts performance period.

lastUpdated.description: The date and time the this request.

date.description: the date of the performance arrays values.

gainLoss.description: The change in market value of the account during this time series (adjusted to remove impact of cashflows).

positionBalance.description: The sum of the value of the positions held in the account (excluding money market funds which are captured in cashBalance) at the beginning date of the time series.

marketValue.description: The market value of the account at the beginning date of the time series. Market value defined as the sum of the position balance and the cash balance.

cashFlows.description: The sum of the inflows and outflows during this time series.

fees.description: The total amount of fees calculated from 4pm of previous day until current time.

income.description: Income in the account for the time series. (Income defined as dividends, interest and capital gains distributions.

rateOfReturn.description: The rate of return for the time series calculated utilizing the Modified Dietz methodology.

beginningMarketValue.description: The market value of the account at the beginning date of the query. Market value defined as the sum of the position balance and the cash balance.

beginningPositionBalance.description: The sum of the value of the positions held in the account (excluding money market funds which are captured in cashBalance) at the beginning date or the query.

beginningCashBalance.description: The cash balance of the account at the beginning date of the query.

endingMarketValue.description: The market value of the account at the ending date of the query. Market value defined as the sum of the position balance and the cash balance.

endingPositionBalance.description: The sum of the value of the positions held in the account (excluding money market funds which are captured in cashBalance) at the ending date of the query

endingCashBalance.description: The cash balance of the account at the ending date of the query.

periodGainLoss.description: The gain / loss for the period defined as the delta of the beginningMarketValue vs endingMarketValue adjusted for cashflows.

periodCashFlows.description: The sum of the inflows and outflows during this period.

periodDeposits.description: The sum of deposits for this period.

periodWithdrawals.description: The sum of withdrawals for this period.

periodFees.description: The sum of trading related fees accumulated during this period.

periodIncome.description: Income in the account for the period. (Income defined as dividends, interest and capital gains distributions.

periodReturn.description: The return for the period calculated by utilizing Modified Dietz methodology.

mtdReturn.description: The month-to-date return for the account calculated utilizing Modified Dietz methodology.

ytdReturn.description: The historic year-to-date year return of the account calculated by joining monthly return statistics. Query will return NULL values if the account has not been open for the duration.

1yearReturn.description: The historic 1 year return of the account calculated by joining monthly return statistics. Query will return NULL values if the account has not been open for the duration.

3yearReturn.description: The historic 3 year return of the account calculated by joining monthly return statistics. Query will return NULL values if the account has not been open for the duration.

5yearReturn.description: The historic 5 year return of the account calculated by joining monthly return statistics. Query will return NULL values if the account has not been open for the duration.

inceptionReturn.description: The historic return of the account calculated by joining monthly return statistics from inception of account to current date.
